view.text: A lamp, a table, a ledger blotched with tidewater. A rope handle marks the boards over the harbor.

location.asset: The tide has taken the ink. What is left is the dent of a name, Thomas Voss, and the dent of an hour already passed. Under it, in the folder's hand: say it where the floor is dry.
A tide clerk's coat, dry on its hook. His hat is under it. Nobody walked out into this rain.

view.text: The ledger is in your coat. The lamp burns. The rope in the floor waits, and the door is behind you.
view.holding: His name, the hour, and her line under it. This floor is a door onto the harbor.

location.asset: A tide clerk's coat, dry on its hook. His hat is under it. Nobody walked out into this rain.
location.ending: The ring comes up in your hand. Black water waits under the shack, and the face from the folder rises to meet you.
The hour is in your coat, and still you open the floor. The face rises, because you brought his name down to the water.
